title: Living on the boat versus rooms ashore
summary: The early seasons were New Orleans in winter and St. Louis in summer with rooms in town; tramp trips later forced the band to live aboard.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: I was asking pops up there a little bit about the band that you had. I always had the idea you stayed on the boat and lived there even in St. Louis, but you had a room out there.
No, we had room ears. See that, when I left the boat, they had began to making tramp trips. You had to live on the boat.
Yeah, I mean those kind of trips.

There would be maybe a week in St. Louis and go maybe a week in Devonport Highway and up to St. Paul, Minnesota and work back and further down the river and then all the way back to New Orleans. And I didn't like living on the boat. The first two years we were up there, we were in New Orleans, the season, winter season. And we were in St. Louis, the summer season. See, and we had rooms in town. We'd knock off at night, go to our rooms or go to a restaurant, anywhere we had to go.
